tools.name: ugcfans_search_templates
tools.description: Lists the ad templates, ad features and creation modes UGC Fans offers, each with its slug, name and a sentence on what it makes. Free, and needs no sign-in. A template slug goes into ugcfans_make_ad as template; a feature slug as feature.

tools.name: ugcfans_get_account
tools.description: Shows the signed-in account's credits left, credits granted and spent this period, when they expire, its plan and whether the account is admitted to UGC Fans. Free.

tools.name: ugcfans_capture_website
tools.description: Opens a public web page in a sandboxed browser, records its text, pictures and layout, and returns a job whose result is a capture id. A capture is the raw material of ugcfans_make_launch_film and ugcfans_make_site_sting. Free of credits. Calling it confirms the person has the right to reuse the pag

tools.name: ugcfans_get_capture
tools.description: Reads a finished capture: the address it ended on, the parts of the page that can go into a film (node_id, role and the first words), and whether a launch film can be made from it. Free.

tools.name: ugcfans_make_launch_film
tools.description: Makes a 12-second launch film of the page's headline, button and picture from a finished capture, in the chosen frame, and returns a job. The result is an editable film; ugcfans_export_film renders it to MP4. Free of credits. A launch film has no text layers: its words are pictures of the page.

tools.name: ugcfans_make_site_sting
tools.description: Makes a 12-second, 8-scene film from the page parts you choose (node_ids from ugcfans_get_capture), in the chosen frame. Unlike a launch film its page text stays as editable text, so ugcfans_set_film_words can change it. Free of credits. Returns the film and its first revision at once.

tools.name: ugcfans_ad_to_film
tools.description: Makes an editable film from a finished video ad, so its captions and end card can be changed, and returns the film and its first revision. The ad must be finished, must not already be a film, must be a video and at most 96 MiB. Free of credits.

tools.name: ugcfans_set_film_words
tools.description: Changes text in a film: every text layer whose words contain find gets replace, and the result is saved as a new revision; the earlier revision stays as it was. Films made by ugcfans_make_launch_film have no text layers, so nothing changes in them. Free of credits.

tools.name: ugcfans_export_film
tools.description: Renders one revision of a film to an MP4 with a content credential, and returns a job; when it is done the result carries a link to the file. Free of credits. A film with an unresolved rendering requirement cannot be exported.

tools.name: ugcfans_finish_clip
tools.description: Runs up to 6 finishing operations in order on a clip of the library, each on the file the one before made: trim, reformat to another frame, burn in captions, overlay a brand logo, close with an end card, or mix in music. Returns the last job, whose result links the finished file. A call that runs pa

tools.name: ugcfans_transcribe
tools.description: Writes out the words of an audio or video file in the library, up to 10 minutes long, with the built-in speech model, and returns a job; when it is done the result has the transcript id, its text, the language and the length. The transcript id feeds the captions operation of ugcfans_finish_clip. Fre

tools.name: ugcfans_list_files
tools.description: Lists files in the account's library, newest first: the path of each (out/...), its size and when it changed. Pictures, video, audio and fonts only. Free. Footage is added at https://ugc.fans/library; the path is what the clip and transcript tools take as source.

tools.name: ugcfans_share_file
tools.description: Makes a link that opens one file of the library for anyone who holds it, without signing in. A link lasts 6 hours; a showcase page, which carries the Made with UGC Fans badge, lasts 30 days. Free. Anyone with the link can see the file until it expires.

tools.name: ugcfans_get_job
tools.description: Reads where a job stands: working, done with its files as links, failed with the reason, or cancelled. Free. Works for any job the account started.

tools.name: ugcfans_wait_job
tools.description: Waits up to 45 seconds for a job to finish and reports where it stands, as ugcfans_get_job does. It returns as soon as the job ends. Free.

tools.name: ugcfans_cancel_job
tools.description: Stops a job that has not yet reached a provider; a cancelled job is not charged. A job that is already with a provider cannot be stopped and the call says so. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "studio" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ugcfans_list_files · Private data: ugcfans_capture_website, ugcfans_export_film, ugcfans_finish_clip, ugcfans_transcribe, ugcfans_list_files, ugcfans_share_file, ugcfans_get_job · Public sink: ugcfans_finish_clip, ugcfans_transcribe, ugcfans_share_file · Destructive: ugcfans_finish_clip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ugcfans_list_files · Private data: ugcfans_capture_website, ugcfans_export_film, ugcfans_finish_clip, ugcfans_transcribe, ugcfans_list_files, ugcfans_share_file, ugcfans_get_job · Public sink: ugcfans_finish_clip, ugcfans_transcribe, ugcfans_share_file · Destructive: ugcfans_finish_clip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
